notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing Mana Vault, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mana Vault from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mana Vault from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, causing creatures you control to get +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the second trigger, allowing you to loot.
Repeat.
